# CLI reference (`blazma-anim`)

```
blazma-anim commands [--json]
blazma-anim new <file.blazanim> [--name NAME] [--json]
blazma-anim inspect <file> [--json]
blazma-anim exec <file> <command-id> [--args '<json>'] [--arg key=value ...] [--no-save] [--json]
blazma-anim run <file> <script.jsonl> [--no-save] [--json]
blazma-anim docs <out-dir>
```

Every command except `new`, `commands` and `docs` also accepts `--attach` (omit the file argument) to drive the running Blazma Animation window instead of a file. `--pipe <name>` overrides the IPC pipe name (tests only).

## Sub-commands

| Sub-command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `commands` | Lists every command with its effect and arguments. |
| `new` | Creates a project containing the default mannequin. Fails if the file exists. |
| `inspect` | Same as `exec <file> project.inspect`. |
| `exec` | Runs one command inside one task, then saves atomically (unless `--no-save`, a read-only command, or a failure). `--args` takes a JSON object; `--arg key=value` can repeat and is converted using the command's schema. |
| `run` | Runs a JSON-lines script (one `{"command":"key.set","args":{...}}` per line; blank lines and lines starting with `#` are skipped) in ONE task. Stops at the first failure without saving; otherwise saves once. Script variables: `${character}` (the project's first character) and `${clip}` (its last clip) are replaced inside string arguments; `"save":{"name":"field"}` on a line stores `data.field` of its result as `${name}` for later lines (e.g. `{"command":"clip.create","args":{"name":"Walk"},"save":{"clip":"clipId"}}`). |
| `docs` | Writes `MCP_TOOLS.md` and `CLI_REFERENCE.md` into the folder. |

## File access (headless)

Commands read files (`rig_import`, `prop_import`, `animation_validate`) from the project folder, the current folder, `--allow-read DIR` (repeatable) or `BLAZMA_ALLOW_READ`, and the write folders. Commands that write files (`animation_export`) only create NEW files, in the project folder, the current folder (unless it is a filesystem root) and `--allow-write DIR` (repeatable) or `BLAZMA_ALLOW_WRITE`. Read folders never grant write. Environment lists use the OS path separator (`;` on Windows, `:` elsewhere). Symbolic links anywhere in a path are resolved before the check. Everything else fails with `path_not_allowed`.

## Output and exit codes

Default output is human-readable text; `--json` prints machine-readable JSON on stdout (for `exec`: the `CommandResult`; for `run`: `{ok, steps:[...], saved}`). Errors go to stderr.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Success |
| 1 | User or input error (bad arguments, file locked, command failed) |
| 2 | Validation failure (reserved) |
| 3 | Internal error |
| 130 | Cancelled (Ctrl+C) |

## Argument details

### `anim.evaluate`

The pose a clip produces at a frame (does not change anything). Returns per-bone rotation/position and the pose JSON. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character id. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | number | yes | Frame (may be fractional). |

### `anim.pose_from_frame`

Set the character's working pose to what the clip gives at a frame (undoable). (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character id. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | number | yes | Frame. |

### `animation.export`

Export a clip as a .glb animation (glTF 2.0 binary) plus a '<name>.blazma.json' sidecar (fps, loop, markers, events, root motion, bone map). The built-in mannequin gets a new file with a simple mesh; an imported character's original file is kept and the animation is appended. Writes files outside the project (the project itself is not changed); agents may only create new files. The written file is re-read and validated. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character to export with (default: the first character using the clip's rig). (min length 1) |
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute path of the .glb to create; its folder must exist. (min length 1) |
| `rootMotion` | string | no | keep (default) \| in_place (remove the root's horizontal X/Z travel, keep height) \| in_place_all (remove all root translation). (min length 1) |
| `startFrame` | integer | no | First frame to export (default 0, or the loop start when the clip loops over part of its length); it becomes time 0 in the file. (min 0) |
| `endFrame` | integer | no | Last frame to export, inclusive (default: clip length, or the loop end when the clip loops over part of its length). (min 0) |
| `sidecar` | boolean | no | Also write '<name>.blazma.json' next to the .glb (default true). |
| `overwrite` | boolean | no | Replace existing files (default false). Ignored for agents, which can only create new files. |
| `validate` | boolean | no | Re-read the written file and validate it (default true). |

### `animation.validate`

Re-read an exported .glb and compare it with the clip frame by frame (position 1e-4 m, rotation 0.01°, scale 1e-4) and check its glTF structure, hierarchy and duration. Returns ok, max errors and issues. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute path of the .glb. (min length 1) |
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character the file was exported with (default: as for animation.export). (min length 1) |

### `character.remove`

Remove a character from the scene (undoable). (effect: destructive)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character id. (min length 1) |

### `clip.accept_draft`

Accept a draft clip (generated motion): it becomes a normal clip (undoable). To discard a draft use clip.delete. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Draft clip id. (min length 1) |

### `clip.add_phase_markers`

Add the 7 key-pose phase markers (Initial … Final) spread over the clip; phases that already have a marker are skipped. Returns {added, markers:[{markerId,name,frame,phase}]}. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |

### `clip.contacts`

Detect foot-ground contacts in a clip (same rules as physics.analyze: a sole point within 'threshold' of the ground and slower than 'maxSpeed'). Returns spans per foot. Does not change anything. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character (default: the first one using the clip's rig). (min length 1) |
| `threshold` | number | no | Contact height above the ground in metres (default 0.03). |
| `maxSpeed` | number | no | Maximum sole speed in m/s for a contact (default 0.35). |
| `minFrames` | integer | no | Shortest contact in frames (default 3). (min 1) |
| `startFrame` | integer | no | First frame to search (default 0). (min 0) |
| `endFrame` | integer | no | Last frame to search (default: clip end). (min 0) |

### `clip.create`

Create an empty animation clip. Returns its clipId. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Clip name. (min length 1) |
| `durationFrames` | integer | no | Length in frames (default: 1 second). (min 1) |
| `fpsNumerator` | integer | no | Frame rate numerator (default: project frame rate). (min 1) |
| `fpsDenominator` | integer | no | Frame rate denominator (default 1). (min 1) |

Delete a clip (undoable). (effect: destructive)

### `clip.foot_lock`

Lock feet during ground contacts: detects contacts, then keys the leg IK targets pinned on one anchor per contact (with knee poles from the motion) and eases on/off over blendFrames. Frames outside contact ± blendFrames keep exactly their original pose. Undoable. Returns spans, maxAnchorError (m) and maxUntouchedChange. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character (default: the first one using the clip's rig). (min length 1) |
| `threshold` | number | no | Contact height above the ground in metres (default 0.03). |
| `maxSpeed` | number | no | Maximum sole speed in m/s for a contact (default 0.35). |
| `minFrames` | integer | no | Shortest contact in frames (default 3). (min 1) |
| `startFrame` | integer | no | First frame to search (default 0). (min 0) |
| `endFrame` | integer | no | Last frame to search (default: clip end). (min 0) |
| `blendFrames` | integer | no | Frames to ease onto/off each anchor (default 3). (min 0) |

Rename a clip. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `name` | string | yes | New name. (min length 1) |

### `clip.retarget`

Retarget a clip from one character to another (rig → rig through the humanoid maps; differently proportioned or imported characters). Creates a NEW normal clip (undoable): mapped bones point the same way in the world, hip/root travel is scaled by the leg-length ratio, animated IK targets/poles are mapped, unmapped bones stay at rest (warning). With footLock (default true) the source's foot contacts are kept planted on the target. Returns clipId and a report. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Source clip id. (min length 1) |
| `fromCharacterId` | string | yes | Character the clip animates now. (min length 1) |
| `toCharacterId` | string | yes | Character to retarget onto (its rig must be humanoid-mapped). (min length 1) |
| `name` | string | no | Name of the new clip. (min length 1) |
| `footLock` | boolean | no | Keep the source's foot contacts planted (pinned IK, default true). |
| `reduceKeys` | boolean | no | Remove keys linear interpolation reproduces within 0.05° / 0.2 mm (default true). |

| `endFrame` | number | no | Loop end frame (exclusive); the clip length means clip end. |

### `key.set`

Record the character's current pose as keys at a frame (replaces existing keys there). By default every bone and IK control; pass 'bones' to key only some. Pass 'props' to also key props' current transforms (offset from the bone when attached, else world); without characterId only the props are keyed. Binds the clip to the character's rig on first use. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |

| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |

| `frame` | number | yes | Frame number (≥ 0). |
| `bones` | string | no | Comma-separated bone/control names or ids; omit for all. (min length 1) |
| `props` | string | no | Comma-separated prop names or ids to key as well. (min length 1) |
| `interpolation` | string | no | step \| linear \| cubic (default cubic for new keys). (min length 1) |

### `motion.generate`

Start generating a motion from a text prompt for a character. Runs in the background and returns a jobId; it does not change the project. Poll motion.job_status, then call motion.job_apply to add the result as a DRAFT clip (undoable), review it, and keep it with clip.accept_draft (or remove it with clip.delete). Provider: kimodo (local AI, must be installed by the user) by default; 'procedural' is a built-in keyword demo (walk, run, jump, wave, squat, idle), not AI. Body only: fingers and face are not generated. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character to animate (its rig must be humanoid-mapped). (min length 1) |
| `prompt` | string | yes | What the character should do, e.g. "a person walks forward". (min length 1) |
| `durationSeconds` | number | yes | Length in seconds (0.2–30). |
| `fps` | integer | no | Frame rate of the clip (default: the project frame rate). (min 1) |
| `seed` | integer | no | Random seed (default: a random one, returned and stored in the clip). (min 0) |
| `provider` | string | no | kimodo \| procedural. Default: kimodo, or the error provider_unavailable when it is not installed. (min length 1) |
| `name` | string | no | Clip name (default from the prompt). (min length 1) |
| `footCleanup` | boolean | no | Pin feet during ground contact (default true). |
| `reduceKeys` | boolean | no | Remove keys that linear interpolation reproduces within 0.1° / 0.5 mm (default true). |
| `loop` | boolean | no | Ask for a loopable motion (procedural only; Kimodo ignores constraints). |
| `inPlace` | boolean | no | Remove travel (procedural only). |

### `motion.job_apply`

Add a finished generation job's motion to the project as a new DRAFT clip (undoable; undo makes the job ready again). Returns clipId. Review it, edit keys, then clip.accept_draft. Fails with job_stale when the project was replaced, or the character was removed, re-rigged or its rig/humanoid mapping changed since the job started; with job_applied when it was already applied. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jobId` | string | yes | Job id (state ready). (min length 1) |
| `name` | string | no | Clip name (default: the job's name). (min length 1) |

### `motion.job_cancel`

Cancel a running generation job you started (stops the Kimodo runner). Does not change the project. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jobId` | string | yes | Job id. (min length 1) |

### `motion.job_status`

State of a generation job (running, ready, failed, cancelled, applied) with progress, warnings and, once applied, its clipId. Without jobId: all jobs. Agents see only the jobs they started. Headless only: waitSeconds blocks until the job finishes (at most 25 s per call; call again to keep waiting). (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jobId` | string | no | Job id from motion.generate (omit to list all jobs). (min length 1) |
| `waitSeconds` | number | no | Wait up to this long for the job to finish (headless mode only, capped at 25 s; ignored in the app). |

### `motion.providers`

List the motion generation providers and diagnostics: is kimodo-runner configured and found, are the model files there, CPU/RAM/GPU (best effort, offline). Never downloads anything. Agents see file names and found flags, not absolute paths. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `probe` | boolean | no | Also start kimodo-runner briefly and ask it for its own diagnostics (only in headless mode; can take seconds). |

### `physics.analyze`

Balance analysis of a clip, frame by frame: centre of mass (COM), foot contacts, support polygon (convex hull of the touching sole points, XZ), signed margin of the tested point to the polygon (inside positive, metres) and balanced/unbalanced/airborne. Returns {summary:{unbalancedRanges…}, frames:[…]}. Does not change anything. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character to evaluate the clip on (default: the first character using the clip's rig). (min length 1) |
| `startFrame` | integer | no | First frame (default 0). (min 0) |
| `endFrame` | integer | no | Last frame, inclusive (default: the clip's last frame). (min 0) |
| `summaryOnly` | boolean | no | Only the summary, no per-frame list. |
| `maxFrames` | integer | no | Most per-frame entries to return (default 120, max 2000); the rest is summarized. (min 1) |
| `metric` | string | no | com (static, default) \| zmp (zero-moment point, uses COM acceleration) \| capture (capture point, uses COM velocity). (min length 1) |
| `minMargin` | number | no | Margin (m) a frame needs to count as balanced (default 0). |
| `contactHeight` | number | no | Sole points at most this high above the ground (m) can touch (default 0.03). |

### `physics.auto_balance`

Move the COM inside the support polygon (by 'margin') on unbalanced frames by shifting the hips horizontally; supporting feet stay planted (legs re-solved with IK). Keys the pelvis translation (and leg rotations of unpinned supporting legs) on corrected frames; every other frame keeps exactly its original pose (frames between the surrounding original keys are keyed with their original values). Refuses (no_leg_ik / track_locked / track_muted) when a supporting foot could not stay planted, unless allowFootSlide. At most 5000 frames and 200,000 keys (too_large). One undo step. Returns before/after margins per frame. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character to evaluate the clip on (default: the first character using the clip's rig). (min length 1) |
| `frames` | string | no | Comma-separated frames to correct; omit to use startFrame/endFrame. (min length 1) |
| `startFrame` | integer | no | First frame (default 0). (min 0) |
| `endFrame` | integer | no | Last frame, inclusive (default: the clip's last frame). (min 0) |
| `margin` | number | no | Distance (m) to keep the COM inside the polygon (default 0.02, max 0.5). |
| `maxShift` | number | no | Largest hip shift (m, default 0.3, max 1). |
| `allowFootSlide` | boolean | no | Correct anyway when a supporting foot has no leg IK chain or its leg tracks are locked/muted (that foot may slide). |

### `physics.com`

Centre of mass and static balance of a character: its working pose, or a clip frame when 'clipId' is given (with velocity, ZMP and capture point). Returns {com, totalMass, massSource, contacts, polygon, margin, state}. Does not change anything. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character id. (min length 1) |
| `clipId` | string | no | Evaluate this clip instead of the working pose. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | integer | no | Clip frame (default 0). (min 0) |
| `segments` | boolean | no | Also list each segment's mass and centre. |

### `physics.secondary_motion`

Bake follow-through / overlap: the chosen bones lag behind the clip's motion like damped springs (stiffness k 1/s², damping c 1/s; mass-independent, stable at any fps). Writes rotation keys on every frame of the range; frames outside it keep exactly their original pose (one undo step). Locked or muted bones are left out (their children follow them as played back). Give 'bones' and/or 'preset'. Work is capped: frames × bones × sub-steps (≤ 1/240 s each) ≤ 2,000,000 and ≤ 200,000 keys (too_large). (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character to evaluate the clip on (default: the first character using the clip's rig). (min length 1) |
| `bones` | string | no | Comma-separated bone names or ids, parent before child for a chain. (min length 1) |
| `preset` | string | no | spine \| head \| arms (humanoid-mapped bones). (min length 1) |
| `stiffness` | number | no | Spring stiffness k (1/s², default 150 ≈ 1.9 Hz; max 10000). |
| `damping` | number | no | Damping c (1/s, default 12; damping ratio = c / (2√k)). |
| `maxAngle` | number | no | Largest lag in degrees (default 30). |
| `startFrame` | integer | no | First frame (default 0). (min 0) |
| `endFrame` | integer | no | Last frame, inclusive (default: the clip's last frame). (min 0) |

### `physics.trajectories`

Per-frame model-space paths of a clip for drawing: centre of mass, hips (pelvis) and/or feet (ankles). Returns arrays of [x,y,z]. Does not change anything. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character to evaluate the clip on (default: the first character using the clip's rig). (min length 1) |
| `what` | string | no | com \| feet \| hips \| all (default all). (min length 1) |
| `startFrame` | integer | no | First frame (default 0). (min 0) |
| `endFrame` | integer | no | Last frame, inclusive (default: the clip's last frame). (min 0) |

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `propId` | string | yes | Prop id. (min length 1) |

### `prop.set_transform`

Set a prop's working transform (only the given components change). Position x/y/z (metres) and rotation rx/ry/rz (intrinsic Euler XYZ, degrees): the offset from the bone when attached, else world. sx/sy/sz scale. Successive calls in one drag merge into one undo step. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `propId` | string | yes | Prop id. (min length 1) |
| `x` | number | no | Position X (m). |
| `y` | number | no | Position Y (m). |
| `z` | number | no | Position Z (m). |
| `rx` | number | no | Rotation X (deg). |
| `ry` | number | no | Rotation Y (deg). |
| `rz` | number | no | Rotation Z (deg). |
| `sx` | number | no | Scale X. |
| `sy` | number | no | Scale Y. |
| `sz` | number | no | Scale Z. |

### `rig.import`

Import a rigged character from a .glb/.gltf file. The file is embedded in the project. Returns characterId, rigId and the bone-mapping report. (effect: external)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute path of the .glb or .gltf file. (min length 1) |
| `name` | string | no | Character name (default: file name). (min length 1) |

### `rig.inspect`

List a rig's bones (name, parent, standard name, rest), controls and IK chains. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rigId` | string | no | Rig id (or use characterId). (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character whose rig to inspect. (min length 1) |

### `rig.map_bone`

Correct the humanoid mapping: give a bone a Blazma standard name (e.g. thigh_l), or omit 'standard' to unmap it. IK chains are rebuilt. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rigId` | string | yes | Rig id. (min length 1) |
| `bone` | string | yes | Bone id or name. (min length 1) |
| `standard` | string | no | Standard bone name; omit to unmap. (min length 1) |

### `rig.mapping_report`

Bone-mapping report for a rig: assignments, missing bones and issues. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rigId` | string | yes | Rig id. (min length 1) |

### `scene.add_mannequin`

Add the built-in humanoid mannequin to the scene. Returns characterId. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | no | Character name (default 'Mannequin'). (min length 1) |

### `sequence.add_clip`

Add a clip to a sequence. By default it starts where the last item ends minus its blend, so it fades in over the end of the previous clip. matchFootPhase picks the inFrame whose foot phase best matches the sequence at the start (less foot sliding in the transition). Returns itemId, startFrame, inFrame. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sequenceId` | string | yes | Sequence id. (min length 1) |
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id (animates the sequence's character rig). (min length 1) |
| `startFrame` | integer | no | Sequence frame where the item starts. (min 0) |
| `inFrame` | integer | no | First clip frame played (default 0). (min 0) |
| `outFrame` | integer | no | Clip frame where a pass ends (exclusive; default: clip length). (min 1) |
| `speed` | number | no | Playback speed (default 1). |
| `loops` | integer | no | Times the in–out range repeats (default 1). (min 1) |
| `blendFrames` | integer | no | Frames to fade in over the previous items (default 0 for the first item, 0.3 s otherwise). (min 0) |
| `blendCurve` | string | no | smooth (default; no velocity jump) \| linear \| ease_in \| ease_out. (min length 1) |
| `matchFootPhase` | boolean | no | Choose inFrame to match the foot phase (default false). |

### `sequence.bake`

Bake a sequence into a NEW normal clip (undoable) that plays exactly like the sequence; export that clip to export the sequence. Returns clipId. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sequenceId` | string | yes | Sequence id. (min length 1) |
| `name` | string | no | Clip name (default: the sequence name). (min length 1) |
| `reduceKeys` | boolean | no | Remove keys linear interpolation reproduces within 0.05° / 0.2 mm (default true). |
| `footLock` | boolean | no | Lock foot contacts of the baked clip (default false). |

### `sequence.create`

Create an empty clip sequence on a character's track (clips played one after another with blended transitions). Returns sequenceId. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character whose rig the clips animate. (min length 1) |
| `name` | string | yes | Sequence name. (min length 1) |
| `fps` | integer | no | Timeline frame rate (default: the project frame rate). (min 1) |
| `alignRoot` | boolean | no | Each clip continues from where the previous one is (default true). |
| `alignYaw` | boolean | no | Also align the facing direction (default true). |

### `sequence.evaluate`

The blended pose of a sequence at a frame and which items contribute with what weight. Does not change anything. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sequenceId` | string | yes | Sequence id. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | number | yes | Sequence frame (may be fractional). |

### `sequence.inspect`

Items of a sequence with their timing (start/end frames, blend, alignment) and the sequence length. Does not change anything. (effect: readonly)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sequenceId` | string | yes | Sequence id. (min length 1) |

### `sequence.remove`

Remove an item from a sequence, or the whole sequence when itemId is omitted (undoable). Clips are not deleted. (effect: destructive)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sequenceId` | string | yes | Sequence id. (min length 1) |
| `itemId` | string | no | Item id; omit to remove the sequence. (min length 1) |

### `sequence.set_blend`

Set an item's fade-in length (frames) and/or curve. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sequenceId` | string | yes | Sequence id. (min length 1) |
| `itemId` | string | yes | Item id. (min length 1) |
| `blendFrames` | integer | no | Fade-in frames. (min 0) |
| `blendCurve` | string | no | smooth (default; no velocity jump) \| linear \| ease_in \| ease_out. (min length 1) |

### `sequence.update`

Rename a sequence and/or change its root alignment options. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sequenceId` | string | yes | Sequence id. (min length 1) |
| `name` | string | no | New name. (min length 1) |
| `alignRoot` | boolean | no | Root alignment. |
| `alignYaw` | boolean | no | Facing alignment. |

### `sequence.update_item`

Change an item's timing: startFrame, inFrame, outFrame, speed and/or loops (at least one). (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sequenceId` | string | yes | Sequence id. (min length 1) |
| `itemId` | string | yes | Item id. (min length 1) |
| `startFrame` | integer | no | Sequence start frame. (min 0) |
| `inFrame` | integer | no | First clip frame. (min 0) |
| `outFrame` | integer | no | Clip frame where a pass ends (exclusive). (min 1) |
| `speed` | number | no | Playback speed. |
| `loops` | integer | no | Repeats. (min 1) |

### `template.apply`

Create a NEW normal clip (not a draft; undoable) from a template on any humanoid-mapped character: built-in templates are generated and retargeted to its proportions; project templates are retargeted from the rig they were saved with (feet locked on contacts). Returns clipId. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | string | yes | Template id from template.list (e.g. builtin.walk_cycle). (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character to animate. (min length 1) |
| `durationSeconds` | number | no | Length in seconds (default: the template's). |
| `name` | string | no | Clip name (default: the template name). (min length 1) |
| `fps` | integer | no | Frame rate for built-in templates (default: the project frame rate). (min 1) |

### `template.delete`

Delete a project template (undoable). Built-in templates cannot be deleted. (effect: destructive)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | string | yes | Template id. (min length 1) |

### `template.list`

List clip templates: built-in ones (idle, walk/run cycles, jump, wave, attack swing) and the project's own (saved with template.save_clip). (effect: readonly)

No arguments.

### `template.save_clip`

Save a clip as a template in the project's library (with a snapshot of its rig, so it can be applied to other characters later). Returns templateId. (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `name` | string | yes | Template name. (min length 1) |
| `description` | string | no | Short description. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character whose rig the clip animates (needed only when the clip is not bound to a rig yet). (min length 1) |

### `track.set_flags`

Lock/unlock and/or mute/unmute a track (at least one flag). (effect: mutating)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `trackId` | string | yes | Track id. (min length 1) |
| `locked` | boolean | no | Locked tracks cannot be edited. |
| `muted` | boolean | no | Muted tracks are not evaluated. |
